description: For a nonempty \(L\)-structure \(M\), \(A\subseteq M\), and formulas \(p(\bar x)\) in \(L(A)\) with a finite variable list, every finite subset is realized in \(M\) if and only if an elementary embedding \(f:M\to N\) into a nonempty structure and a tuple \(\bar b\) realize \(p\) with every parameter \(a\) interpreted by the specified value \(f(a)\).
